description: The loaded build driver was the version at commit 977e0cf. Its source file was edited for CI verification mode while this process was still running. Per-record script hashes were read from disk and may therefore identify edited source rather than the code already loaded by the process.
consequence: Retain compilation successes and raw attempts, but exclude this batch from source-frozen timing claims. A replacement driver captures provenance at launch and rejects driver/input changes.
